title: Cloud and Custom Dynamic Inventory
objective: Discover ephemeral hosts and construct reliable groups from metadata.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Cloud inventory plugins query provider APIs and group instances from tags, regions, states, and other metadata. Cache settings balance freshness against API load.
Multiple sources can combine static and dynamic hosts. add_host and group_by create in-memory groups; a custom inventory source must implement the documented list and host behavior.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Discover ephemeral hosts and construct reliable groups from metadata.
